theorem_title: Claim 4.2: boundary bound for connected squares
formal_statement: theorem AngelDevil.connectedSquares_perimeter {s : Finset AngelDevil.Point} (h : AngelDevil.SquaresConnected s) : AngelDevil.squarePerimeter s ≤ 2 * s.card + 2 := by sorry
natural_language_statement:
Let $S$ be a finite nonempty set of integer unit squares, connected by shared sides, and let $P(S)$ count all unit boundary sides, including boundaries of holes. Then

$$P(S) \le 2|S|+2.$$

This is the connected-square perimeter estimate used in the wall-counting argument for the Angel strategy.
source: Mathe, The Angel of power 2 wins (2007), https://doi.org/10.1017/S0963548306008303, author manuscript p. 6, Definition 4.1 and Claim 4.2.
